topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I just found out there's a hidden room in this house. Of course, the real estate agent didn’t bother to mention it. Great. Just what I need, another space to dust and clean. And it’s not even a decent size—barely fits a chest and some old, cobwebbed books. Probably why they didn’t want to show it. Who needs a secret stash for junk, anyway? I should have known better than to buy a fixer-upper. Now I get to deal with this mess. Well, it’s not going to clean itself, is it? Guess I’ll start by throwing out all this useless clutter.
